subject: LAB-043
check: Source, privacy, rights, accessibility, and live-route boundaries
steps: Read the shared page/model, live adapter, intent operation path, original offers, and qualification walkthrough.
Probe the installed iOS AlarmKit interface through labr and read Apple S33 and S01 primary sources.
Review publication inputs: test source, metadata records, and prose only; no screenshot, recording, or exported media.
Read Apple AlarmKit documentation JSON at https://developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation/alarmkit.json after the HTML/Markdown reader failed.

outcome.detail: Review records the actual boundary: CoreLocal uses an unavailable system adapter; only SystemSurfaces compiles AlarmKit/UserNotifications. Original fixed-date offers contain neutral text. Cancel passes stored lab IDs only. Reset does not call system cancel; schedule discards errors; intents change domain rows without host system scheduling. Repeated Add button labels and unverified announcement/keyboard behavior remain accessibility findings. No live or accessibility pass is claimed.

limitations: Static review is not a permission, delivery, UI, or accessibility run.
Apple HTML exposed a JavaScript shell and the Markdown reader failed; the official documentation JSON was retrieved and read. Documentation is not live execution evidence.
Physical iPhone, system notification/alarm delivery, Focus in Settings, Watch experiment behavior, manual accessibility, and 26-SDK compilation are not-run.
